verdict.rationale: Zep documents a full public API (Python/client SDKs) used throughout quick-start and reference docs (thread.add_messages, graph.edge.delete, three-line integration, sub-200ms retrieval), plus a CLI (zepctl) and MCP server exposing the same capabilities—strong first-party evidence of a documented, driveable API surface. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of API usability/completeness beyond vendor docs.
